correction.old_incorrect_date_implication: ODNI 2.0 treated as a 2026 announcement in draft language.

structure_state.official_fact_sheet: ODNI 2.0 says functions within FMIC are being refocused and core functions/expertise integrated into Mission Integration and the National Intelligence Council; it also states that elements within NIC and NCSC already monitor foreign influence efforts targeting the American public.
structure_state.public_site_ambiguity: ODNI public organization material may still display FMIC. Therefore do not claim FMIC is definitively abolished solely from the fact sheet.
structure_state.safe_routing_rule: Ask NCSC to route to the current responsible component(s), including NCSC, Mission Integration, NIC and/or FMIC as appropriate.

electronic_route.fallback: ODNI Office of Strategic Communications public correspondence
